preconditions.description: The number of strings in the array A must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in A)
preconditions.description: Each string in the array A must have a length between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == len(A[0]) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All strings in the array A must have the same length.

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the set of deletion indices D.

postconditions.expression: all(A[i][j] <= A[i][j+1] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[i]) - 1) if j not in D)
postconditions.description: After deletions, each string in the array A must be in lexicographic order.
